chunks: From him, from Safwan, from al-'Ala', from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
He was asked about a man placing his hands on the ground before his knees. He said: Yes—meaning in the salat (prayer).
ai.seo_question: Is it permissible in salat (prayer) to place the hands on the ground before the knees when going into sajdah?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses the manner of descending for sajdah in salat (prayer). It indicates the permissibility of placing the hands on the ground before the knees during prayer, making it relevant to prayer rulings and bodily posture in worship.
